title: Great Market Tour
text: We had a wonderful market tour and lunch with Libor. We started with wine and botifarra while Libor explained the history of the neighborhood and market. Then we met several vendors and sampled seasonal fruits, cheeses and olives. After the tour, we had a typical Carolinian lunch with more wine and beer. The perfect way to start the day in Barcelona!
author: Carter_C

title: Eat like a local! With a true local!!!
text:
Eli's wonderful tour reminded us that Barcelona isn't just a fun and accessible European city. Barcelona is in Catalonia, with it own unique cultural and culinary history. 

Don't just see the Gaudí sites! Stroll a local market with a great local guide and have an authentic Catalonian meal. Eli was super kind and rescheduled the tour to accommodate our busy tourist visit. 

The guides we've had in Spain have been lovely but interestingly mostly from other countries. Having Eli was like meeting up with an old friend from Barcelona to show us around. She's the best! Highly recommended!
author: ehonda415

title: Great tour!
text:
We could not having happier! It's was perfect way to see the city and eat away. 
Be hungry when you go on this tour, because the food is a must try everything 😋
